hero_tagline.zh: 机器人及机器学习，机甲大师（Robomaster）

tb_focus_value.zh: 机械 · 嵌入式 · 软件

about_body_1.en: I'm a Robotics Engineering student. I design the mechanical system and write the software that runs it — CAD and fabrication at one end, embedded firmware and ROS nodes at the other, and the control loop in between.
about_body_1.zh: 我是机器人工程专业的学生。机械结构和驱动它的软件都由我做——一端是 CAD 与加工，另一端是嵌入式固件与 ROS 节点，中间是控制环路。

about_body_2.en: Outside of engineering, I enjoy photography and running

projects_subheading.en: Autonomy, control, and the hardware underneath — plus a few things built for their own sake. Most rows link to the repository.
projects_subheading.zh: 自主导航、运动控制及其底层硬件，以及一些纯粹出于兴趣的项目。多数条目可跳转至代码仓库。

proj_humanoid_title.zh: 模仿学习双臂包裹处理

proj_humanoid_desc.en: A dual-arm humanoid that picks a parcel, judges whether its shipping label is showing, and flips it if not — learned from 200 VR demonstrations rather than programmed. I built the deployment side: policy output becomes motion only through a transparent IK solver and a physics check.
proj_humanoid_desc.zh: 双臂人形机器人从台面抓起包裹，判断快递单是否朝上，不朝上就将其翻转——这套动作由 200 组 VR 示教学习而来，而非编程写定。我负责 policy 之外的部署链路：自建 IK 求解器与下发前的仿真校验，是策略输出成为实际动作的唯一通路。

proj_slam_title.zh: 精准对接货物运送机器人

proj_slam_desc.en: A TurtleBot3 that explores a maze, finds ArUco markers, and launches balls into a receptacle unaided. I built the mechanics and the docking that squares it to the marker's normal.
proj_slam_desc.zh: 自主探索迷宫、识别 ArUco 标记并将球射入接收装置的 TurtleBot3。我负责全部机械设计，以及使车身对正标记法线的精准对接。

proj_pcb_desc.en: Three KiCad boards carrying two CAN buses and three power rails across the rotating yaw joint of a RoboMaster sentry, each rail paralleled over several slip-ring channels in poured copper.
proj_pcb_desc.zh: 三块 KiCad 电路板，在 RoboMaster 哨兵持续旋转的 yaw 关节两侧传递两路 CAN 总线与三路电源；每路电源以敷铜并联分摊到多个滑环通道。

proj_aimbot_title.zh: 便携式自瞄测试移动靶

proj_aimbot_desc.en: A spinning armour-plate rig that mimics robot movement and records where each projectile lands, so auto-aim testing no longer ties up a second robot and a driver — and packs down to travel to the competition. A two-person project; I own the mechanical design.
proj_aimbot_desc.zh: 旋转靶架：以装甲板模拟机器人运动，并记录每发弹丸的落点，使自瞄测试不再占用第二台机器人和一名操作手，同时可拆装装箱、随队出行。两人项目，我负责全部机械设计。

proj_arm_desc.en: A 6-DOF arm built from scratch: structure modeled in SolidWorks, driven by hobby servos, and controlled by a Python inverse-kinematics solver.
proj_arm_desc.zh: 从零设计并制作的六自由度机械臂：SolidWorks 建模、舵机驱动，由自编 Python 逆运动学求解器控制。

proj_lightpanel_desc.en: Triangular panels that interlock in any arrangement: 3D-printed shells, laser-cut acrylic diffusers held on a lip by friction alone, screwed together in pairs. The mating tolerances took several CAD revisions. Wiring was the weak point — I could not solder yet, and the bought-in connectors dropped out and left panels flashing.
proj_lightpanel_desc.zh: 可任意拼接的三角形灯板：外壳 3D 打印，激光切割的亚克力扩散板仅靠凸缘摩擦卡住，两块之间以螺丝相连。配合公差前后改了好几版 CAD。接线是短板——当时还不会焊接，外购的连接件接触不良，常让灯板闪个不停。

proj_speaker_desc.en: A two-driver Bluetooth speaker built from a published tutorial, and my first electronics project: the printed enclosure, the wiring, and every solder joint in it are mine. Chasing down its noise is what taught me that a switching converter couples straight into the audio path.
proj_speaker_desc.zh: 依照公开教程制作的双单元蓝牙音箱，也是我的第一个电子项目：外壳打印、走线和其中每一个焊点都由自己完成。排查底噪的过程让我明白，开关变换电路会直接串进音频回路。

bloomcraft_desc.en: A florist assistant that turns an occasion into a costed bouquet. An LLM constrained to structured JSON picks from a priced catalogue, so the total is arithmetic rather than a guess.
bloomcraft_desc.zh: 将场合需求转化为带报价花束方案的花艺助手。LLM 的输出被约束为结构化 JSON，并从带价目的花材库中选配，使总价来自计算而非估测。

proj_portfolio_desc.en: A minimal bilingual portfolio in React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, deployed to Vercel behind a custom domain.
proj_portfolio_desc.zh: 使用 React、Vite 与 Tailwind CSS 构建的极简双语作品集，部署至 Vercel 并配置自定义域名。

contact_subheading.en: I'm open to internships, research collaborations, and interesting side projects.
contact_subheading.zh: 随时欢迎实习、科研以及有趣项目
